R6I-moose-atv-0004.name: 810 m S of Corduroy Creek
R6I-moose-atv-0004.pressureWhy: No town, pavement or rec site within 1 km and not behind a closure (estimate).
R6I-moose-atv-0004.parkWhat: where the truck road ends (Moricetown-Suskwa FSR); unload the ATV (all terrain vehicle)

evidence.t: 10 wetlands within 2 km; nearest 2.6 ha, right here.
Cutblock harvested 2015 (11 years old), 130 m SE: browse.
Moose winter range u-6-040 unit 710 (official), right here. Counts from November.

seasonRows.notes: MU 6-8 is not listed in the Region 6 moose rows (my reading of the table).

plan: Drive: from City of Terrace, about 144 km (straight line times 1.3, estimate). Via Beam Station Rd, Queensway Dr, Hwy 16, Hwy 16 and 37.
Park: 55.16678, -127.37034, where the truck road ends (Moricetown-Suskwa FSR); unload the ATV (all terrain vehicle). Map links below.
Ride: 1.7 km on Access To Cpee by ATV (all terrain vehicle) or 4x4 on rough road, estimate. Then walk 370 m NE, climb about 0 m.
Hunt: moose, season: VERIFY. Glass the wetland and cutblock edges at dawn and dusk. Move slowly, stop often (Tip).
Use: .308 Winchester, 165 to 180 grain premium bullet, shots inside about 200 m (219 yd) (Tip).
Legal: MU (Management Unit) 6-8, Region 6. Season rows below. Study aid only. The official regulations are the law.
Verify: Candidate, scout it first. Check posted signs. Private land can be unsigned. Data dates: roads 2026-10-16, private land 2026-10-01, closures 2026-10-16.
R6I-moose-atv-0004.popWhy: Less popular (quieter): MU 6-8: about 2,313 hunter days a year for moose (2020 to 2024 mean), 0.24 days per square km, middle third of BC MUs; access: average access. Estimate, about 50% sure (my pick).

tags.label: Good for 2
tags.why: Cover edge here (cutblock or burn): one hunter sits at a crossing or glasses, the other walks the edge slowly with the wind at their back toward the stander. Agree zones of fire, a meeting point and a time at the truck (Tip, lesson: Hunting with a partner). Pushes are on foot only (99%, synopsis page 11, item 25).

tags.label: Good solo
tags.why: Short pack out: 0.4 km and about 0 m of climb from the parking (Tip). Cell coverage is not in the data: leave a trip plan and carry SOS or a satellite messenger (lesson: Bush safety).
